name: Openai-whisper-api
description: Transcribe audio via OpenAI Whisper, Atlas Cloud, or MuAPI speech-to-text APIs.
prompt:
# Audio Transcription APIs (curl)

Transcribe a local audio file through OpenAI Whisper (default), Atlas Cloud, or MuAPI speech-to-text.

## Quick start

```bash
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider atlas
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider muapi
```

Defaults:

- Provider: `openai`
- OpenAI model: `whisper-1`
- Atlas Cloud model: `xai/stt-v1`
- MuAPI endpoint: `openai-whisper`
- Output: `<input>.txt`

## Useful flags

```bash
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.ogg --model whisper-1 --out /tmp/transcript.txt
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider atlas --language en
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider muapi --prompt "Peter"
{baseDir}/scripts/transcribe.sh /path/to/audio.m4a --provider muapi --json --out /tmp/transcript.json
```

For Atlas Cloud, `--prompt` is sent as one transcription key term and must be at most 50 characters. Atlas and MuAPI submissions are sent once, then polled with bounded GET requests until completion. MuAPI uploads the local audio before submission; its Whisper endpoint accepts files under 25 MB in mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, wav, or webm format.

## API keys

Set `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ATLASCLOUD_API_KEY`, or `MUAPI_API_KEY` (`MU_API_KEY` is also supported). You can also configure provider-specific keys in `~/.CoWork-OSS/CoWork-OSS.json`:

```json5
{
  skills: {
    "openai-whisper-api": {
      apiKey: "OPENAI_KEY_HERE",
      atlasApiKey: "ATLAS_KEY_HERE",
      muapiApiKey: "MUAPI_KEY_HERE",
    },
  },
}
```

MuAPI reference: https://muapi.ai/playground/openai-whisper/api
